record.question: They always talk _____________ never think. Complete the sentence by supplying appropriate connecting word.
record.explanation: The printed page 6 (Q58, April 2019 Paper-I, Section B) gives 'They always talk _____ never think.' with options that, who, whomever, which. 'Who' is the relative pronoun for people, here referring to 'they' (those who talk without thinking), so it is the grammatically correct connective.
